title: LILA SWIPE telemetry events
description: Four event types, one queue. Every event of every type carries persona, exec_id, deck_id, kind (card kind, or both kinds for duels), hand_id, replay, and ts. Attribution is per interaction row, never per session wrapper. event_id is the idempotency key; the server upserts on it.

exec_id.description: opaque, from the deck token; never a name or email

replay.description: second full play under the same token; never silently mixed with first-play observations

swipe_distance.description: signed, normalized to card width, negative left. RAW, always captured.

swipe_velocity.description: normalized widths per second at release

intensity_bin.description: display bin only; final relevance mapping lives in training code

reason.description: chip slug or null; ignore is a valid label

streak_at_swipe.description: game-state: for the casino-bias monitor check

since_bonus_event.description: game-state: swipes since last between-hand bonus

oneOf.title: ordering
oneOf.description: One per hand, persisted independently the moment it is submitted, so abandonment preserves completed hands.

oneOf.title: super_like
oneOf.description: The authoritative super-like record; the swipe row does not carry the flag. One per hand, immediate (lever pulled at swipe) or retroactive (number-one card promoted on the hand ordering screen).

oneOf.title: duel
oneOf.description: Direct pairwise preference: two cards side by side, tap the winner. Highest-information gesture per second.
